title: Show HN: Optio – Orchestrate AI coding agents in K8s to go from ticket to PR
summary: Open-source orchestration system that turns tickets into merged PRs using AI coding agents (Claude Code/Codex). Auto-merges PRs after CI passes. Runs in K8s pods with self-healing on CI failures. Direct competitor/complementary pattern to PP.

title: Show HN: G0 – The control layer for AI agents (scan, test, monitor, comply)
summary: Security/governance layer for AI agents with 1,180 rules, red teaming, runtime monitoring, kill switch, and compliance mapping. Claims 'control layer' positioning similar to PP. First-class OpenClaw support mentioned.

title: Show HN: DevOpsAgents – AI agents to deploy and manage your infra
summary: AI agents that analyze GitHub repos, deploy infrastructure, and manage it ongoing. Agents SSH into resources and fix issues autonomously. Example of agents with deployment authority.

title: Microsoft APM – Agent Package Manager for Agent Configuration
summary: Microsoft/GitHub engineer built package manager for AI agent configs. Deploys to Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode. Includes 'apm audit' for supply-chain attack scanning. Shows enterprise interest in agent governance.

title: Claude Code multi-agent spawning
summary: Claude Code docs now describe multi-agent spawning with lead agent coordination for merging results. Official Anthropic documentation of agent orchestration patterns.

title: AI usage red flag? - r/ExperiencedDevs
summary: Senior dev complains teammate uses Claude Code for PRs without validation. Teammate trusted Claude's analysis for performance issue without verifying. High-velocity AI output but no quality gates. 'Who approved this?' problem. 344 comments means high engagement.

title: How to manage vibe coders, backed by leadership - r/ExperiencedDevs
summary: Tech lead of 20+ engineers struggles with 'vibe coders' shipping 5000+ diff PRs per day. Code is 'complete garbage and incredibly fragile'. Leadership backing high-velocity AI users over quality. Classic governance gap - no enforcement layer between agent output and merge.

title: We let Claude write 100% of our code for 7 days. Here's what broke first.
summary: Rankfender team ran 7-day experiment with Claude writing all code. Day 1: rollback needed because 'AI doesn't think about side effects'. Day 3: 'false confidence trap' with 800 lines of beautiful but broken code.

title: Sweet! CLI - Cheaper Claude Code/Codex alternative with 'autopilot'
summary: New today. CLI agent with 'autopilot' mode for indefinite autonomous work. Author claims 'multiple Sweet! agents deployed to production server right now' for monitoring. Agents with always-on deploy authority.
